items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: a trumpet player by the name of Paul Thomas

ctx.x: How frequently would you say -- were you a regular vocalist?

No. No. I became a regular vocalist with them I'd say around 1934 or '35, maybe earlier than that, which was another group altogether. Harry was in it, but it was a larger group. They had piano, drums, guitar of course with Jess in there. They also had Harry on alto. And they had a very good tenor player by the name of Hen Pie, that was his nickname, and a trumpet player by the name of Paul Thomas. And then they had a male singer, Al. I don't remember Al's last name. He also played drums.
